duff_args.description: List of configuration arguments. Each item must specify an 'arg' key and optionally 'value'. Valid 'arg' values are: digest_function, format, limit, recursive, excess_mode, null_terminated, quiet, physical_mode, thorough_mode, empty_files, hidden_files, follow_symlinks_cmdline, follow_symlinks_all, no_follow_symlinks. See 'duff(1)' manpage for details.

duff_files.description: List of files and directories to scan. If empty, duff reads from stdin.
